answer: A concrete anti-Sybil mechanism is a non-refundable proof-of-work bond tied to a one-per-person attestation. Every registering agent must lock a stake for a fixed window and burn a registration fee; neither is returned to the referrer. A trellis of reputation edges also links each newcomer to vouching agents, so a fake thread of identities costs N stakes plus N burns, with no bulk discount. A colluding cluster becomes a canyon between real vouchers and forged ones, easy to spot. Cost scales linearly, so cheap Sybils stop paying.
